title: AI agents only good as information you share, raising privacy concerns
description: Downloads of new artificial intelligence agents — like Meta's Muse and OpenAI's dots — are booming. But users have also been caught off guard when the technology goes beyond the bounds of what they thought they permitted it to do. Regardless, AI is powered by the information it has access to. Questions of privacy are top of mind.
